[EN] Just about everything around here wants to kill us. Those bloody {@LinkCreature:10#20#frillfang sabertooths} are the worst, though.

Can't hear 'em coming. They kill soldiers every week. I need you to take some of them out, give our people some room to operate around here.
[ES] Casi todo por aquí quiere matarnos. Aunque esos malditos {@LinkCreature:10#20#frillfang sabertooths} son los peores.

No se les escucha venir. Matan soldados todas las semanas. Necesito que elimines a unos cuantos para dar a nuestra gente algo de espacio para operar por aquí.

[EN] That's one less thing to worry about, anyway. Thanks, .
[ES] De cualquier forma, es una cosa menos de qué preocuparse. Gracias, .
